text:
Maria: Heads up — after rolling a new fp8 profile set C to a small slice this morning we saw a ~1.4% regression on the summarization QA corpus for /v1/generate-summaries. Suspect staleness/eviction issues with lowbit profiles. Thoughts?

Sam: ugh. can you paste the metric + hostpool?

Maria: summarization_f1: 0.872 -> 0.860, affected route /v1/generate-summaries, dedicated-prod-us-east-1 (small % of traffic). No infra errors.

Lee: probable profile mismatch — profile was created during heavy perf tuning last week, may not have been revalidated against current tokenizer or recent prompt drift. we need an eviction/quarantine policy for profiles that go stale.

Nora: what about a TTL by default? e.g., if a profile hasn't been validated in 24h mark as stale.

Devon: ops POV: TTL is fine but must be graceful. on stale -> route to higher-bit fallback (int8 or fp16) rather than failing the request.

Sam: sketch of how config might look:
```
quant_profile_eviction:
  ttl_hours: 24
  min_shadow_hits: 1000
  drift_threshold: 0.02  # relative quality delta
  on_eviction:
    fallback_to: int8
  quarantine_duration: 72h
  hysteresis_window: 6h
```

Maria: how do we compute `drift_threshold`? per-endpoint perplexity vs a canonical eval set?

Lee: use hybrid signal: lightweight live metric (e.g., perplexity / ngram delta) + scheduled shadow-eval result (our degscore/regression tests). if both indicate degradation, mark candidate for eviction. also watch for shifts in cache-key distribution.

Nora: runtime telemetry needs to emit `profile_last_validated`, `profile_shadow_hits`, `profile_drift_score` per profile id so ops can make decisions.

Devon: alerting: add an SLO alarm if eviction rate > 1%/hr during a rollout. we had a case where many profiles got evicted and we saw thundering fallbacks.

Anya (QA): we can add a canary harness that forces fallback when profile is flagged stale to validate user-facing impact before full eviction. playback against recent traffic.

Maria: rollout proposal: 1) canary shadow: keep profile attached but shadow to fallback; 2) soft-eviction: prefer fallback on 95% traffic but keep profile for 5% for faster follow-up diagnostics; 3) monitor 48h; 4) if stable, full eviction and quarantine for `quarantine_duration`.

Sam: API: we should expose `GET /profiles/:id/health` returning last_validated_ts, shadow_hits, drift_score, quarantined_until. useful for console and engineers.

Lee: important to avoid thrash — implement hysteresis + `min_quarantine_before_reuse: 24h`. also require at least `min_shadow_hits` before evicting to avoid noisy decisions on low-volume endpoints.

Devon: ops-bot: please create a ticket for TTL + telemetry + alerting. assign to @Nora.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-1234 created: "Implement quant profile eviction + telemetry & alerting". Assignee: Nora. Priority: P2.

Nora: Assigned. I'll draft an RFC for API + runtime hooks and post by EOD Wed.

Maria: Action items: Nora RFC, Sam implement config knobs in runtime, Lee define exact drift calculation and thresholds, Anya set up canary harness + playback. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Devon: noted.

Sam: I'll start a PR for config schema + a minimal runtime flag to opt-in soft-eviction.

Anya (QA): will queue a playback job and share the test graph.

Nora: will follow up with RFC link in this thread when ready.
